title: A statement line read as a card payment meets the ticked one: it attaches to the bank side (final_review_2 S1c, decision Q1)
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000. A card closes on the 15th and is paid on the 10th of the next month (moved later) from the bank; its statement of 15 Dec holds 50,000, not paid yet. On Mon 11 Jan the check-in ticks the card payment of 50,000. On Mon 18 Jan the bank statement is read, and the reader knows the line is the card company: it reads it as a payment from the bank to the card, on the bank's statement (`account` is the bank). It meets the ticked payment on its bank side and attaches there. Every amount is made up.

events.note: the bank statement's line, read as a card payment

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 300,000 (opening) - 50,000 (card payment, Mon 11 Jan; the statement line attaches to its bank side) = 250,000
